metric_definitions.repeat_flip_rate: Unordered-pair disagreement probability among repeated non-UNCERTAIN verdicts under the same item, judge, prompt variant, and displayed order.
metric_definitions.position_sensitive_fraction: Fraction of matched item/judge/prompt/candidate-pair groups whose resolved modal normalized verdict differs across A/B and B/A display orders; unresolved repeated-vote ties are excluded.
metric_definitions.prompt_sensitive_fraction: Fraction of matched item/judge/display-order groups whose resolved modal normalized verdict differs across prompt variants; unresolved repeated-vote ties are excluded.
metric_definitions.cross_judge_kappa: Matched-condition, repetition-collapsed pairwise Cohen's kappa, weighted by overlap across judge pairs.
metric_definitions.claim_interval: Wilson interval over one collapsed modal verdict per independent dataset item; repeated judge calls are not independent task samples.
